description: The FAIRiCUBE project publishes a GeoJSON feature collection for about 700 European cities with a 2018 reference year. The public codebook lists city outlines and identifiers, elevation statistics, sealed and tree-covered shares, Urban Atlas land-cover areas, and population and socioeconomic measures with source links and units. The file could supply city-level context for comparing infrastructure demand, urban heat exposure or resilience scenarios across places. Zenodo lists the GeoJSON, codebook and an environmental-zone codelist under CC BY 4.0. A city is the unit of observation; this is not a street or asset inventory. Some fields may be missing and source reference years differ despite the collection label. One codebook row describes an unemployment rate but labels its unit as a number of inhabitants, so that field needs checking before use. Upstream Eurostat and Copernicus terms remain separate. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this named city-feature release; its GeoJSON was not downloaded or checked for completeness.
name: City features collection
